question: The peasant struggle of the Warli tribe in the year 1945 occurred in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Warli tribe** is an indigenous tribal group primarily residing in the **western region of Maharashtra**, particularly in the districts of **Palghar** and **Thane**.
